rules.message: New extension: add a README Resources row and a usage section.
New single-file extension: add a README Resources row.
New skill: add a README Resources row.
New prompt: add a README Resources row.
New record: frontmatter needs title, date, session, and based_on (docs/README.md, Records).
Record from another session changed: add a dated entry under ## Amendments if facts, evidence, scope, conclusions, design, or the next action changed (typos, formatting, and link repairs need none).
Closed backlog item: add one '- Closure:' line with the result link or drop reason.

judgments.text: Work the final answer leaves open is either finished, asked about in one batched question, or registered as a candidate with a reason it cannot be done now (outside data or time, a blocker, or user deferral). Defects in the request's own work are not deferred.
A record that replaces an earlier record cites it in based_on, and the earlier record received a follow-up or replacement link.
A change to standing rules or constraints beyond one feature (for example AGENTS.md or docs/README.md) is recorded in an ADR under docs/adr/, not only in a plan.
Project terms newly introduced or renamed in docs are added to docs/glossary.md (renamed terms kept as Deprecated).
Code adapted from a reference implementation or external package keeps applicable attribution and license notices.
